notes: Design SSOT recipe (empire-wonder-surfaces wonder-display §Design 1). Mounts inside the existing SectorInspector slots block — no new route (GG-1/GG-7). Changing IA = editing this recipe, not the TSX. Slot tree: identity + effect-reading + progress + locked-slot → wonder-display fold (pure) → events → wonder-display.* bus (closed). Shared density consumed by name: capacity-meter[progress] for the rising meter, stock-row for relic-candidate rows (4D.1-owned, never forked); the treasure shelf (wonder-relic-shelf, sibling inventory program) is linked, never re-implemented.
fold: foldWonderCard (gk-web/web/fusion-rpg-web/src/stages/world/wonderDisplay/wonderDisplayFold.ts — pure data, no paint, no copy)
bus: wonder-display.* — card.expand, reading.open, teaser.explain, retry (wonderDisplayBus.ts — closed, pieces never fetch)
catalog: gk-data/packs/fusion/data/seed/display/wonder-display.v1.json (GG-62 authored lexicon — names, effect sentences, refusal copy + next actions, locked reasons, unknown-id placeholder, pending cap copy)
rules: Built Wonder renders name + badges + effect with no progress slot; under-construction renders name + rising sentence + shared meter.
Unique renders the live cap line from WonderPolicy numbers (N of cap raised); Common renders no cap line (uncapped by construction).
Pre-catalog cap reads render the designed pending state — never a guessed number, never a hidden row.
Reserved scopes (World/Multiverse) render as locked teasers with the catalog reason — never hidden, never buildable.
Wire reason strings never render raw; unknown structureIds render the placeholder + card.expand — never the id.
Paint arrives from wonder-scope-*/wonder-rarity-* packs only; no hard-coded scope/rarity colour map in piece code.
Copy arrives from the display catalog only; the fold formats magnitudes (GG-46) and invents none.
